NDT training in Shreveport, LA: how it works

Short answer: In Shreveport and Bossier City, NDT theory is taken self-paced on the Atlantis online portal, with an ASNT NDT Level III on hand for questions from the day you enroll. You rehearse in the Practical NDT browser simulator and do the hands-on work in person at your employer's plant, mill or field location. Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Shreveport. Your employer certifies you under ASNT SNT-TC-1A, or you take ASNT central exams.

Northwest Louisiana looks nothing like the coast. The inspection market here is built on natural gas from the Haynesville Shale, the pipe and tube that carries it, a specialty refinery, heavy manufacturing at the Port of Caddo-Bossier and a large Air Force base across the Red River. Technicians in the Ark-La-Tex move between pipeline construction, gathering and compression work, mill inspection and plant maintenance, so a broad foundation in the surface methods and UT pays off.

The training is arranged so a working technician can fit it in. Theory sits on the portal and you study it when you can. Practical skill is earned on real welds and pipe at a Shreveport-area employer, recorded as supervised experience. Your employer's examinations and signature are what turn that into a certification.

Ask us about Shreveport NDT training, listing the methods, levels and head-count you have in mind. We reply within one business day.

How to get NDT certified in Shreveport: the SNT-TC-1A path step by step

Pipeline contractors, inspection companies, mills and plants in Caddo and Bossier parishes commonly certify to written practices based on ASNT SNT-TC-1A. Here is the order in which the pieces come together.

  1. Start with the written practice. The Shreveport employer's document lists each method and level and spells out the training hours, experience hours, exams and eye tests required. Check your own starting point with the eligibility checker.
  2. Take the classroom-equivalent hours for the method on the portal; see the hours planner for the recommended minimums.
  3. Collect field or shop experience under a certified Level II or III, whether on pipeline girth welds, mill pipe or plant equipment, and keep it in a signed record.
  4. Write the general exam covering the physics, equipment and terminology of the method.
  5. Write the specific exam built on the employer's procedures and the acceptance criteria in its contracts, for example API 1104 for a pipeline contractor.
  6. Perform the practical exam on specimens with known conditions, graded by or under a Level III.
  7. Pass the vision tests for near acuity and color contrast at the interval the employer sets.
  8. Be certified by your employer, which signs and holds the certification record.
  9. Recertify on schedule; SNT-TC-1A recommends an interval of no more than five years.

A technician who wants certification that is not tied to one employer can sit ASNT central examinations, ASNT 9712 for Level I and II or the ASNT NDT Level III exams, and Atlantis prepares candidates for both. More on the employer route: SNT-TC-1A certification explained.

Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 NDT courses for Shreveport technicians

All courses follow the SNT-TC-1A body of knowledge. New technicians usually begin with Level 1 training, step up to Level 2 training when their experience log allows, and look at Level III preparation once they run a program. The last column ties each method to Shreveport-area work.

MethodWhat the course coversWhere it is used around Shreveport
UTCalibration, thickness and lamination scanning, angle-beam weld examination, reportingWall-thickness surveys on gathering lines and plant piping, weld examination on fabricated equipment, tube and pipe mill inspection
PAUT and TOFDEncoded scanning, setup files, data interpretation and sizing for experienced UT Level II staffPipeline girth welds where the owner accepts automated or semi-automated UT, heavy-wall welds
RTExposure planning, image quality, film and digital radiography, interpretationPipeline girth welds to API 1104, plant piping repairs and pressure vessel welds
MTMagnetizing techniques, continuous and residual methods, particle selectionWelds on compressor skids, structural steel, pipe ends and threaded products
PTProcess steps, sensitivity, dwell times, interpretation and post-cleaningStainless and non-magnetic components in plants, aircraft and support equipment
VTDirect and remote visual techniques, weld profile, gauges and acceptance criteriaWeld visual on every pipeline and plant job, coating and corrosion assessment, receiving inspection
ETImpedance-plane theory, probes, calibration standards, surface and tubing techniquesHeat-exchanger tubing at the refinery and plants, crack detection on aircraft structure and parts

The Level III course prepares candidates for the ASNT Basic and Method examinations and gives practice in drafting procedures and examinations, which is the core of a Level III's job for a Shreveport inspection company or plant.

Ultrasonic testing (UT) training in Shreveport

UT is the volumetric method most Shreveport employers ask for. On gas gathering and transmission work it starts with thickness readings on pipe, fittings and vessels at compressor and treating sites, and moves on to angle-beam examination of welds. At tube and pipe mills, ultrasonic inspection of product is part of meeting the purchase specification, and technicians need to understand calibration standards, reference reflectors and reject criteria. The UT course covers these foundations and how to record results that an owner can audit.

On pipeline construction across the Haynesville, radiography of girth welds remains common, and many crews pair RT with UT. If you are heading for pipeline work, plan on RT training and UT, with VT throughout, because visual inspection of every weld comes before anything volumetric.

Where NDT technicians work around Shreveport

Haynesville Shale gas. The Haynesville is one of the largest natural gas plays in the country, spreading across northwest Louisiana and east Texas. Drilling pads, gathering lines, compressor stations, treating plants and the transmission pipelines that move gas toward the Gulf Coast all need weld inspection during construction and thickness and corrosion surveys in service, mostly to API 1104 and ASME B31.8.

Pipe and tube manufacturing. Benteler Steel/Tube operates a steel tube mill at the Port of Caddo-Bossier, producing seamless tubes and threaded products, and has added capacity there in recent years. Mill inspection relies on automated UT and electromagnetic systems backed by manual UT, MT and VT, all run to the product specification.

Refining. Calumet's Shreveport refinery produces specialty products such as lubricants, waxes and solvents. Refinery maintenance and turnarounds use UT thickness, RT, PT, MT and ET, with inspection programs run under the API in-service inspection codes. Some employers also want inspectors who hold API individual certifications; those are separate from SNT-TC-1A method certification.

Military aviation. Barksdale Air Force Base in Bossier City is home to B-52 bomber wings and Air Force Global Strike Command. Aircraft inspection on the base is performed by the Air Force's own NDI personnel under military technical orders. Civilian contractors and suppliers that support aviation in the region follow their customers' requirements.

Power and manufacturing. Utility power plants, fabrication shops and industrial plants across the Ark-La-Tex call on UT, MT, PT and VT for maintenance, outages and new construction to ASME and AWS codes.

NDT schools and classes near Shreveport: what to compare

Someone searching for NDT classes near Shreveport will see programs in Texas and south Louisiana, plus online options that combine self-paced theory with a practical at an employer. Before paying for anything, check that the training will count under the written practice of the company that hires you.

  • Which document defines the course content, and is the completion record specific about method, level and hours?
  • Which Level III stands behind the material, and in which methods is that Level III certified?
  • How and where is the practical done, and does it use the kind of parts you will inspect: pipe, plate welds, castings?
  • Is the goal employer certification, an ASNT central examination, or both?
  • Will the record still be useful if you move to a different employer in the Ark-La-Tex?

The Atlantis approach: theory self-paced online with Level III Q&A, simulator practice in the browser, and the hands-on practical and practical examination in person at the employer's facility under its written practice. The published US fees for each course are listed on this page, and Register & Buy Now opens the course on the Atlantis portal. The NDT training FAQ answers the usual follow-up questions.

Online NDT training in Louisiana

Pipeline and field technicians in north Louisiana often work long, irregular days, so self-paced study suits them. On the Atlantis portal you open a module whenever you have time, go back over anything that did not stick and send questions to the Level III. There are no fixed sessions to miss.

The practical portion cannot be done online. Every Louisiana employer that certifies to SNT-TC-1A wants supervised hands-on hours and a practical examination on real parts. For the rest of the state, read NDT training in Louisiana; for national context, NDT training in the USA.

Training a crew at your Shreveport facility (employers)

A Shreveport pipeline contractor, inspection company or plant that needs to qualify several people can put them through the theory online, then run hands-on training and practical examinations in person at its own facility, using its own instruments and representative parts. That way the specific and practical exams test exactly the techniques and acceptance criteria the crew will apply on the next job.

Many smaller Ark-La-Tex companies also need their program paperwork tidied before an owner audit. Written practice development rewrites or reviews the document, and ASNT Level III consulting covers procedure review, examination preparation and certification file checks. See corporate NDT training for how group training is arranged.

Radiography licensing in Louisiana

Because Louisiana runs its own Agreement State program, Shreveport radiography crews answer to the state rather than directly to the NRC. The Louisiana Department of Environmental Quality licenses companies that possess radiography sources, under LAC 33, Part XV, and people who operate those sources must hold industrial radiographer certification recognized by LDEQ after radiation safety training and supervised trainee experience. Crews that also work over the line in Texas or Arkansas need to meet those states' requirements too.

The NDT method course does not cover any of that. Radiographic testing training teaches technique, image quality and interpretation toward SNT-TC-1A certification. Radiation safety certification is separate and runs through the employer's licensed program. Check LDEQ's current rules before you plan on radiography work.

Practice before your practical exam

The Practical NDT simulator lets you practice scanning, calibration and interpretation in a browser. For Shreveport work, try the process plant scenario, the radiography simulator and the UT simulator. It is rehearsal: simulator hours are not logged experience and do not replace a practical examination on real parts.

The free NDT practice tests help you check your theory before a general examination.

Frequently asked questions about NDT training in Shreveport

How long does it take to become an NDT technician in Shreveport?

The employer's written practice decides. Theory takes the least time; the logged experience hours for Level I and then Level II take the longest.

What is the cost of NDT training in Shreveport?

Course fees for the US are published in the table on this page. For a group at a Shreveport or Bossier City employer, contact us and we will reply within one business day.

Is online NDT training available in Shreveport?

Yes, for the theory. The hands-on practical and the practical examination happen in person at your employer's site.

Is there an NDT school near me in Shreveport-Bossier?

Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Shreveport or Bossier City. Theory is online and practical work is done at the employer. Compare any school against the questions above.

What NDT method should I start with for Haynesville pipeline jobs?

VT first, then RT or UT, depending on what the contractor uses for girth welds. MT is useful on fittings, skids and structural welds.

Are there NDT jobs around Shreveport?

Pipeline construction, gas gathering and compression, tube manufacturing, refining, plant maintenance and fabrication all employ NDT technicians in the area. Pipeline hiring follows drilling and construction activity in the Haynesville.

Can I use my NDT certification in Texas and Arkansas too?

SNT-TC-1A certification belongs to your employer and covers that employer's work wherever it operates. Radiographers also need the radiation safety certification of each state where they handle sources.

Does my certification transfer to a new employer?

No. A new employer reviews your training and experience records and certifies you under its own written practice. ASNT central certification moves with you.

Can I prepare for ASNT Level III from Shreveport?

Yes, online and self-paced. See ASNT Level III training.

Who teaches the Atlantis courses?

Anoop Rayavarapu, an ASNT NDT Level III in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT with more than eleven years of international field experience.
